title: Presence: in-system player list and toasts
description: Every client sees who else is in the current system: a live player list (callsigns), join/leave toasts, and the per-system occupancy count feeds the star chart.
acceptanceCriteria: Client maintains inSystemPlayers: Map<playerId, {callsign, shipId, onFoot?}> built from the join snapshot and presence_join/presence_leave events (TASK-12)
Player list HUD (bottom-left, minimal): callsigns with a small status dot (in-ship vs on-foot); updates within one snapshot of a change
Toasts: 'CALLSIGN joined' / 'CALLSIGN left' (non-intrusive, top-right, 3 s fade); toast flood limited to 3 visible (queue the rest)
Occupancy: GET /api/galaxy/health (TASK-11) data feeds the star chart — systems with active shards show a player count badge (TASK-7 consumes it)
WS integration test: 3 clients in one system — each sees exactly the other 2 in its list; one leaves — the other two update within 1 s; one joins a different system — not listed
npm run test green; Playwright smoke: join with two browser contexts, both lists show both callsigns (screenshot)

steps.details: src/client/net/presence.ts: PresenceStore with join/leave/leaveAll (on system change); subscribable (simple event emitter); excludes own callsign from the list but shows a '(you)' marker.
PlayerList React component (bottom-left, compact, monospace); ToastStack (top-right). Both read PresenceStore; no re-render per snapshot (only on presence events).
WS integration test per acceptance; Playwright two-context smoke with screenshot. Run full suite + typecheck.

technicalNotes: No ping/latency display in v1 (was cut for scope); the store keeps a lastSeen timestamp in case it returns.
onFoot flag arrives with TASK-36; the store field exists from the start (optional).
